title: Dhani
desc: Two despicable brothers murder their employer and throw his son into the river. When the boy survives and grows up, he decides to take revenge.

title: Banaras
desc: A man from the future falls in love with a woman from the present. He then decides to do everything to save his relationship at all costs.

title: Bhajarangi
desc: A cruel god-man rules and harasses the people in a village. Jeevan, who comes to the village to learn about his ancestors, ends up bravely fighting against him to save the villagers.

title: Diggajaru
desc: A rich landlord and his servant bond well irrespective of their status. When the landlord accidentally commits a murder, the servant decides to take the blame on himself.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
desc: Rocky successfully rises as the leader and saviour of the people of the Kolar Gold Fields. But, in his goal to fulfil his mother's wishes, Rocky must tackle Adheera, Inayat Khalil and Ramika Sen.

title: Kalidasa Kannada Meshtru
desc: When the existence of his school is threatened, Kalidasa, a Kannada teacher who loves teaching the language, raises his voice against the education system that leans towards private schools.
